temporal_notes: Collections done 22-26 April (pre-intervention) and 29 April - 2 May 2013 (post-intervention).
source_text: The study was conducted in Ragwe village, in the Suba south sub-county in Homabay county of Nyanza Province in Western Kenya... Mosquito collections were performed four times prior to intervention (April 22, 24, 25, and 26, 2013) and four times after intervention (April 29, 30, May 1, and 2, 2013).
